title: The new checkoutMainFn uses node:child_process spawnSync, consistent with the m…
body: The new checkoutMainFn uses node:child_process spawnSync, consistent with the module's existing import and explicitly directed by the story note. This is not a new violation, but the module remains a candidate for the ongoing Bun-first spawn migration (cf. CAM-308 which migrated scripts/check-all.ts). Non-blocking.
